registryBasis: The national Ministry of Land Affairs and its formal search procedure are evidenced, but no Malemba-Nkulu local registry/cadastre service or public parcel layer was evidenced. The official Haut-Lomami circonscriptions page lists Kamina and Kanyama, not Malemba-Nkulu.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official form describes a formal, identity-bearing land search workflow and asks for a province/circonscription, property references, and supporting documents; it is not an anonymous parcel geometry service. No form was submitted.
Official page lists 143 land/cadastral circonscriptions and Haut-Lomami entries Kamina and Kanyama. No Malemba-Nkulu entry, viewer, service URL, schema, or CRS was exposed.
Official ministry homepage exposes laws, land services, and digitisation references but no public parcel map/API for this city.
Public-facing cadastral information site claims coverage across 26 provinces, but the inspected landing page exposed no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint or safe city-specific response.
